posts.description: 小抄阅读适合读英文书的中文读者。它会在你可能不认识的词下面放中文提示。点一下单词，看贴合这句话的释义；需要时，再打开整句翻译。界面和释义都是中文，书籍需要自己导入 EPUB。 还可以用阅读引导跟着当前行读。使用同一 Apple 账号并开启同步后，iCloud 可以同步阅读进度和主动收藏的生词；书籍要在每台设备上自行导入。

Agents collaborate, execute tasks, review results, and deliver work under your control. Start free with built-in Managed AI and Git hosting. No API keys or GitHub account required. Bring your own tools whenever you're ready.

posts.name: Verse
posts.tagline: Completely free AI music generator. No sign-up needed.
posts.description: Turn your lyrics into songs with Verse, a completely free AI music generator. Choose your genre, mood, tempo and vocals, then create a track up to 2 minutes long in your browser. No account or payment required. Explore song ideas and share 15-second previews in the Render Lounge.

posts.name: SoneBoost
posts.tagline: Automated SMM panel & digital marketing growth platform
posts.description: SoneBoost is an all-in-one automated SMM panel designed for agencies, resellers, and digital marketers to scale their social media presence efficiently. Unlike traditional manual services, SoneBoost offers seamless reseller API integrations, secure automated payment gateways (like Cryptomus & Heleket), robust order processing, and user-friendly dashboards.

posts.name: Catalogist
posts.tagline: A free WordPress catalog for college programs and courses.
posts.description: Catalogist is a free WordPress plugin for community and technical colleges: semester-by-semester program maps with pathways, course pages with linked prerequisites, searchable program and course lists, and spreadsheet import.

posts.name: YOBIOKO
posts.tagline: The alarm you can only stop by typing today's tasks
posts.description: YOBIOKO is an alarm you stop by typing your own tasks for today. What makes it different: - Typing your tasks is the alarm: it pauses while you type and rings again if you stop for 5 seconds. - When it stops, you are awake and your plan for the day is already in your head. - Snooze is limited to 2 times, plus an optional wake-up check. - Woke up early? Type one phrase to skip the rest of today's alarms. - Get a morning score out of 1000 and one of 16 morning types.

posts.name: Stackora App
posts.tagline: Your own online store in minutes. Try free for 30 days.
posts.description: Stackora helps small businesses create their own online store in minutes, without coding or configuring hosting. Enter your business details, choose a template, and let the platform generate your website. Add products, photos, and prices, then manage products and orders from your dashboard. Hosting and SSL are included. Start with a 30-day free trial on the Go plan, with yearly plans from $79.

posts.name: 3DJ.app
posts.tagline: AI-assisted CAD and 3D creation for makers and agents
posts.description: Create 3D concepts and editable parametric CAD in your browser. 3DJ combines CAD scripts with text-to-3D and image-to-3D exploration: export STEP/STL from CAD, or generate GLB models through remote MCP agent workflows. Built for makers, product designers and prototyping teams by Neural Deep Network. Explore accessories, objects and early design ideas, then check dimensions, tolerances and printability before production. From creative brief to a model you can inspect, refine and prototype.

posts.name: Pull2.me
posts.tagline: Download media and simplify everyday creator tasks
posts.description: Pull2.me is a free browser-based toolkit for downloading supported public Instagram and TikTok media and completing everyday creator tasks. Save available videos, Reels, slideshow photos, and audio, or use simple tools for image conversion, compression, resizing, OCR, and text formatting. No Pull2.me account or extra software installation required. Built around a clean, straightforward experience.

posts.name: PromptStudio.ai
posts.tagline: Bad prompt in. Great answer out.
posts.description: PromptStudio.ai is an AI prompt engineering studio. Prompt Lab turns any rough idea into an optimized prompt; Prompt Doctor scores your prompt out of 100 and rewrites it. Includes a prompt library, image-to-prompt, and code prompt tools. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Groq.

posts.name: AskYourStack
posts.tagline: Let your AI run your server and SEO, safely
posts.description: Connect Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor to your Linux server, Google Search Console, GA4, Bing and Cloudflare over MCP. Your AI sets up the server, installs Magento or WordPress, reads logs, fixes errors and audits your SEO. Risky actions wait for your approval, and snapshots let you roll back.
